title: SurtGIS: a high-performance raster geospatial analysis library, CLI and dynamic tile server in Rust
description: High-performance geospatial analysis library and CLI in Rust: 127 algorithms (56 also available in the browser via WebAssembly), streaming I/O for arbitrarily large DEMs, native CRS reprojection, windowed GeoTIFF and Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF reads, a native ECW decoder, an end-to-end satellite composite pipeline, and — since 1.4.0 — SurtGIS Server, an analysis-first dynamic XYZ tile server (`surtgis serve`) where terrain operators, spectral formulas and colormaps are tile-URL parameters. Covers terrain analysis, hydrology and remote sensing from a single dependency-free binary. This record archives the source of release v1.4.0.
